subject.title: bug: withAllowedHostname only updates allowedHostnames, not hostnameAllowlist — breaks navigate with non-empty hostnameAllowlist

question: Should OpenClaw fix this by adding the selected CDP host to both exact hostname policy fields for CDP control traffic, or by passing a separate CDP-control policy into Playwright session helpers?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the repair changes how a browser SSRF policy exception is represented and current tests encode part of the stricter behavior.

options.title: Accept the scoped helper fix
options.body: Land the open PR shape if review confirms the helper is only used for CDP control-plane grants and remote/page navigation guards stay strict.

options.title: Move to a distinct control policy
options.body: Require a follow-up shape that passes CDP-control policy separately through Playwright lookup while leaving navigation policy objects untouched.

options.title: Keep strict allowlist behavior
options.body: Document that users must add the CDP host to `hostnameAllowlist` and close the fix PR as not planned.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped helper fix
recommendation.body: Land the open PR shape if review confirms the helper is only used for CDP control-plane grants and remote/page navigation guards stay strict.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most direct recent history on the shared SSRF helper and CDP policy docs.
